lightwave_auth_method.title: Lightwave Smart Configuration
lightwave_auth_method.description:
{discovered_hub}Choose your authentication method.

**Account Linking** (recommended) signs in directly on Lightwave via your browser without entering your password in Home Assistant.
**Refresh Token** signs in with your Lightwave email and password once without storing your password.

user.title: Lightwave Smart - Password Authentication
user.description: {discovered_hub}Enter your Lightwave email and password. Password Authentication stores the password in Home Assistant.

data_description.instance_name: Optional, your username will be used if not provided

refresh.title: Lightwave Smart - Refresh Token
refresh.description: {discovered_hub}Enter your Lightwave email and password. They are used once to create a refresh token and are not stored.

data_description.instance_name: Optional, your username will be used if not provided

reauth_confirm.title: Lightwave Smart - Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Lightwave needs you to sign in again. Continue to choose Account Linking, Refresh Token, or Password Authentication.

confirm_account_change.title: Different Lightwave account
confirm_account_change.description: This integration is set up for {current_account}. You signed in as {new_account}. Continue to replace this setup with the new account, or cancel to keep the current one.

confirm_additional_account.title: Lightwave Smart is already set up
confirm_additional_account.description:
Lightwave Smart is already set up as {existing_accounts}. Home Assistant cannot tell whether that is the Lightwave account you just signed in with.

If it is the same account, close this dialog. Adding it again would show your devices twice.

Submit only to add a different Lightwave account.

oauth_auth_method.title: Lightwave Smart - Account Linking Configuration
oauth_auth_method.description: {discovered_hub}You will be redirected to Lightwave to authorize the integration. Once authorized, you will be redirected back to Home Assistant to complete the setup.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Lightwave service. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please check your username and password.
error.invalid_auth_method: Invalid authentication method. Please select a valid authentication method.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

abort.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: A different username was given, the original username is required. Please enter the original username or delete the integration and try again.

user.description: When the Link Plus is also paired with HomeKit, hide the controls HomeKit already shows.

reset_enabled_status_to_defaults.name: Reset Enabled Status to Defaults
reset_enabled_status_to_defaults.description: This will reset entities enabled statuses to defaults

link_disconnected.description: The connection to Lightwave has been down for two minutes. The link keeps trying to reconnect. This repair is removed when the connection is back.
